invariants.statement: A modifier on a rate stat whose base is 0 must use the flat channel; percent on zero base is a dead value. finalDamageReductionPercent is signed (min -1) so designed damage-taken downsides land. hpBelow/hpNotBelow passive conditions partition disjointly at the threshold.
validStates: flat modifiers on zero-base stats; signed clamps admit -1 floor
forbiddenStates: percent modifier on a stat whose base+flat is always 0
invariants.failureBehavior: clampStatValue clamps to min/max; -2 -> -1 for finalDamageReductionPercent
invariants.inverseBehavior: hpNotBelow active iff ratio >= percent; hpBelow iff ratio < percent
oracles: TalentsV4Wiring.test.ts asserts flat<0 + hpNotBelow condition; StatCalculator pool math

invariants.statement: A building's unclaimed accrual window prices rate/capacity/material under the realm pinned when the window opened; claim() settles under the pin, then re-pins to the current realm. Legacy saves without accrualRealmId fall back to current realm (unchanged behavior).
forbiddenStates: accrued backlog repriced at a newer realm on claim
invariants.failureBehavior: unknown realm id -> index -1 -> default rate/tier 1 (soft)
invariants.atomicity: claim computes remainder under pinned rate before re-pin
uiConsequences: capacity/rate display equals what claim pays
oracles: BuildingSystem.test.ts EM-01 cases: breakthrough mid-window, claim re-pin, legacy fallback

invariants.statement: Offline cultivation splits the save->now window at persistent-effect expiry boundaries; each segment converts seconds via calculateOfflineProgress at its own live percent. A buff expiring mid-window stops paying at expiry. Repeated restores of an identical payload are no-ops.
forbiddenStates: boosted-rate x whole window when buff expired mid-window
preconditions: persistentTimedEffects is an array (shape gate enforced)
legalTransitions: expiresAtMs inside window creates a boundary
illegalTransitions: effect with expiresAtMs <= start still pays
uiConsequences: offline summary shows actual post-cap amount
oracles: TuLinhTranBalance.test.ts segment boundaries; player.restoreFromSave.test.ts EM-02 cases

invariants.statement: Remote reconcile orders by save_revision first (shared clock-free sequence) with updated_at only as same-revision tie-break. Pushes are CAS PATCH guarded on the just-read revision; a lost race returns 'unavailable' without regressing local data. Push revision never goes below remote+1. updated_at is server-owned via DB trigger.
validStates: remote revision strictly advances on push
forbiddenStates: older-revision remote row resurrects via client clock skew; push overwrites a newer remote revision
postconditions: local revision adopts remote+1 lineage after successful push
legalTransitions: pull when remote ahead; push when local ahead; same-rev -> timestamp tie-break
invariants.atomicity: single PATCH statement is the CAS
invariants.persistence: localStorage revision key adopts pushed revision
uiConsequences: conflict -> unavailable surfaces a retry, not silent loss
oracles: SupabaseRemoteSave.test.ts: CAS PATCH shape, zero-row conflict, revision-adopt, clock-skew pull

invariants.statement: Player sprite nameplates render the authored player name obtained through the optional getActivePlayerName() reporting member; a gate without it falls back to 'Player'. The pre-created combat sprite label is synced on snapshot reconcile.
